policy.human_identity_key: team + jersey number; unknown jersey excluded from identity pairs
policy.same_pair_rule: consecutive mapped observations of the same human player
policy.different_pair_rule: 20 nearest-in-time mapped observation pairs from the same team with different human jersey identities
policy.mapping_rule: human marked the ball handler/shooter; endpoint mapped to P2 control/shot actor track at the reviewed time. Ambiguous mappings are excluded.
policy.unknown_policy: do not force ambiguous human-to-track mappings
